text: Swimming is a wonderful form of exercise that offers a full-body workout. One of the most rewarding aspects of swimming is the ability to track your progress. For beginners, starting with a set of laps can be a great way to build endurance. As your swimming skills improve, you can gradually increase the number of laps you swim. Goggles are not a necessary item for starting out, as water contact is not required for laps. Focus on getting comfortable in the water and maintaining a steady pace to see the most benefits from swimming.
